_comment: WS1/W6 FINAL HEADLINE sweep — the 'big enough virialized + doubly tamed' config. Geometry='virialized' with vir_relax_steps=1 = FORCE-BALANCED lattice (inner virialization residual ~1e-30; both mass rules virialized). vir_mass_rule='massfunc' (log-normal mass draw + segregation by rank — the more realistic relaxed-cluster mass function the user preferred); vir_mass_spread=0.8 (strong, visible mass segregation); vir_n_nodes=80 (big enough that inner nodes have a near-symmetric surround AND multi-shell, so 'inner' nodes really are inner — under vir_relax_steps=1 the radial layering comes from the cubic-lattice ball's node count, NOT vir_extent, which is a no-op in the force-balanced mode); vir_segregation=1.0; vir_s_metric='median'. SLINGSHOT TAMING: node_softening_gpc=1.0 ('doubly tamed' = virialized structure + 1 Gpc Plummer node softening; matches the particle softening and collapses the runaway tail). start_size_scale=1.0 (LCDM-implied size, byte-identical a(t) shape lever OFF). centerM=1 (no extra outer mass). Selection = min chi2/dof vs REAL Pantheon+ among anchor_ok rows (objective='pantheon'); chi2_lcdm~0.436 / chi2_eds~0.843 are REFERENCE benchmarks ONLY, stamped per row. TIGHT near-LCDM band per PF4: M in {200,500,1000,1500,3000}, S co-fit (linear) in [20,45] (LOW S; high S is the wrong part of the landscape). Isotropic headline: node_mass_amplitude=0 (PF2: anisotropy is the falsifiable signal, not the isotropic chi2; amp=0 isolates geometry). 400 particles / 273 steps / t_start=2.9 Gyr (the consistent kernel used for every pinned number). RESUMABLE: per-cell checkpoint in results/ws1_sweep_virialized_final.csv (re-run skips done cells).
